baseColor: Decode sRGB once, then apply linear material/vertex/instance tint and procedural variations. Do not include AO or lightmap illumination.

dataMaps.ao: linear red channel; indirect visibility, not base color
dataMaps.normal: linear RGB tangent normal, preserve handedness and both signed strengths
dataMaps.alpha: linear opacity/mask, preserve cutoff and sidedness

unsupported: Unknown custom shaders fail or are explicitly unavailable. World-space wear, parallax, grass variation, anisotropic normal strength and omitted bump maps require adapters. Texture-only export is not shader parity.

windowInterior.semantics: Opaque UV-tiled muted room silhouette, deterministic by UV cell. Visual substitute, not measured interiors; no emissive fill or white placeholder.
windowInterior.owner: AI562 production exporter; AI566 isolated laboratory adapter
